Furthermore, the equity is demonstrating strong underlying momentum, sitting firmly at 100% of the way up its 52-week range of 0 low to 9 high [E4]. Conceded: the negative trailing P/E of -4.95x [E5], the complete lack of dividend yield at 0.00% [E3], and the severely depressed profitability metrics including an ROA of -30.45% [E7] and an ROE of -34.04% [E8] compared to sector benchmarks.

Noble Polymers Ltd exhibits severe operational distress, evidenced by a deeply negative return on equity of -34.04% compared to a sector benchmark of 10.43% [E8]. This fundamental weakness is compounded by a return on assets of -30.45%, which stands in stark contrast to the sector benchmark of 4.68% [E7]. The company’s inability to generate profit is further confirmed by a negative P/E ratio of -4.95x [E5]. Investors receive no compensation for these risks, as the dividend yield is 0.00% [E3]. Conceded: the stock is trading at a price-to-book ratio of 1.23x, which is lower than the sector benchmark of 2.58x [E1, E6]. Despite these poor performance metrics, the stock is currently trading at 100% of its 52-week range, suggesting that the market price has reached its peak despite the underlying financial deterioration [E4].
